name: Automatic Site Icon Picker
project_description: Provides a single field formatter (id "automatic_site_icon_picker_link", label "Link (favicon)") for core link fields. When a link field is rendered with this formatter, the module extracts the host from each URL, requests a PNG favicon for that host from the external Vemetric Favicon API (https://favicon.vemetric.com), caches the downloaded image under public://social-media-icons/, and renders it as an next to the link. Display can be configured as icon only, icon + URL, or icon + title, at 16px/32px/64px, with an optional open-in-new-window (target=_blank) option. Depends only on core field; no custom routes, services, permissions, entities or config objects are provided.
